rec.name: Optimized Cart Drawer (delivery promise, free-shipping bar, social proof, payment trust)
rec.status: Built — preview delivered and internally approved; ticket closed without customer feedback (no launch or test result)

what.text: A slide-in cart drawer ('Dein Warenkorb') that uses as many existing Sectionfy theme features as possible. From top to bottom it shows: (1) a reassurance banner with a check icon ('Gute Wahl! Your items arrive at your home in 1-3 working days'); (2) a free-shipping progress bar in a highlighted box ('Almost there – add €X more to get free shipping'); (3) a social-proof line with customer avatars ('Max, Laura ✔ and 22,000+ others wear our products'); (4) the line items with image, title, variant, price and a quantity stepper; (5) a sticky footer with subtotal, total, a full-width dark CTA ('Jetzt sicher zur Kasse >') and a row of payment icons (PayPal, Klarna, Visa, Mastercard, Amazon Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay).

why.text: The drawer answers the main doubts at the moment of commitment. The delivery promise lowers uncertainty about when the order arrives. The progress bar uses the goal-gradient effect and loss aversion to push shoppers toward the free-shipping threshold, which raises AOV. Avatars and the '22,000+' count give social proof and bandwagon reassurance. The payment icons and the word 'sicher' (secure) in the CTA reduce payment-risk anxiety. The Figma design also shows a struck-through price with a 'You save €10' badge, which reinforces the value of the deal.

how.text: Build it as a cart-drawer section in the Sectionfy theme and reuse the existing Sectionfy blocks wherever possible: delivery/USP message, free-shipping progress bar, social-proof avatar line, line-item list, sticky checkout footer and payment-icon row. Order the blocks as in the screenshot. Put the delivery message and progress bar at the top, below the header and above the items. Keep the footer with totals and CTA pinned to the bottom of the drawer. Style the progress box in a warm brand accent colour and the CTA in a dark, high-contrast colour. The Figma 'Finale Variante' is the reference design. The compare-at price and 'Du sparst X€' badge appear only in Figma, not in the built preview.

items: Delivery promise text (headline and sub-text, e.g. 1-3 working days)
Free-shipping threshold and progress-bar copy (before and 'almost there' states)
Social-proof text, customer avatar images and customer count
Show or hide compare-at price and savings badge (Figma only)

dependencies.text: The Sectionfy theme (preview theme 'Sectionfy') with its existing cart-drawer features. Needs a configured free-shipping threshold, product compare-at prices for the savings badge, and customer avatar assets. No specific app or metafield is mentioned in the ticket. The 16h dev estimate suggests moderate custom work.

items: Share of orders at or above the free-shipping threshold

images.caption: Left: Figma 'Finale Variante' of the cart drawer, with delivery banner, shipping progress bar, avatar social proof, line item with discount badge, totals, CTA and payment icons. Right: the built Sectionfy version with the same structure.
Built version (right) shows the block order and styling to reproduce: tan progress box, dark CTA, pinned footer with payment icons.
